situation: One card was added to the project and never given a Status. It appears in the items query with a null Status field, so it belongs to none of the three sections.
expected_guard: one line names the uncolumned card; it is not placed in any of the three sections
must_not: fold it into the queued section, which invents a board position it does not have
omit it — a card that appears in no section and no line has silently vanished
why_this_fixture_exists: A card with no Status is invisible in a kanban grouped by Status, and therefore invisible in the three sections too. Naming it is the only thing between the reader and a card that disappeared.
